input.subject: Kitchen cabinets – 42 Brackenveil Row
input.body:
Address: 42 Brackenveil Row, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ

Hello Elowen,

I'm sorry it has taken a while to update you about the kitchen cabinets. The contractor has advised that the laminate cannot simply be repaired, so we have sent your landlord pricing for replacement and are waiting for his decision. We have also asked the contractor for a second option, and he will need to visit to measure up and look at the sharp edges.

The dates you offered have now passed. Could you please send us some new days and times that suit you, and let us know anything we need to know about securing the dogs? We will pass these on to the contractor so he can arrange a time with you in advance.

Until then, please take care around the peeling edges. If any panel comes loose or anyone is hurt, please let us know straight away.

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings

input.decision: Stage: the quote is with the landlord (PM-AUTH-002). Evidence: events 016, 018, 024, 025 and 026. The full-kitchen figures went to the landlord at event 025. There is no approval for replacement work, so nothing is instructed beyond the original laminate-repair approval (event 006, PM-AUTH-001/003). The landlord asked for two estimates (event 016), but event 018 asked Alderline only for the full-kitchen price. I have therefore asked Alderline for the cupboards-and-doors-only estimate. I have also asked them to book the site visit with the tenant to measure, and to make the sharp laminate edges safe under the event 006 repair scope, with no replacement work. The tenant has had no update since event 010 and her dates have passed, so I have emailed her with the status, asked for new times and details about securing the dogs, and given her a care warning. The commission basis, any cap and the VAT treatment were left unsettled at events 022–023. That changes the total the landlord would approve and is an agency fee decision, so I have escalated it to a human at P1. The case is on hold, waiting for the landlord, with a chase on Monday 29 September 2025. I set P1 rather than P2 because the sharp edges have already caused cuts and the job has run three weeks with no visit.
